title: Keep the delivery lifecycle repository-owned and Manual-first
context: VolleyBro must remain fully deliverable when Symphony is unavailable or replaced, while unattended execution should reuse the same approved plan.
decision: Root WORKFLOW.md and repository adapters own the complete delivery lifecycle. Symphony may claim and invoke only the approved Apply contract and does not own specification, review, Archive, or human acceptance.

alternatives.option: Make Symphony the workflow and process owner
alternatives.reason: Manual delivery would depend on the runtime and repository knowledge would become coupled to one orchestrator.

alternatives.option: Maintain separate Manual and Symphony workflows
alternatives.reason: Two execution contracts would drift and produce different delivery evidence for the same Change.

consequences: Manual and Symphony Apply consume the same Blueprint slices and verification contract.
Repository policy remains usable across provider and orchestrator replacements.
revisitTriggers: A future orchestrator-neutral standard can preserve the same Manual execution guarantees with less repository policy.
